rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with the Tickory platform to provide real-time cryptocurrency scanning on Binance spot and perpetual markets. Supports creating scan rules with CEL expressions, running immediate or scheduled scans, listing alert events with pagination, and generating human-readable explanations of alert triggers and suppressions through scoped API keys.
